rules.rule_name: Holistic Internship and Job Offer Evaluation
rules.explanation: Evaluating offers based solely on short-term financial compensation while ignoring mentorship, tech stack quality, and growth potential harms long-term career trajectory.
rules.do: Evaluate offers holistically by weighting mentorship availability, engineering culture, tech stack modernity, learning velocity, and total compensation equally.
rules.dont: Do not accept or reject offers based purely on base salary numbers without assessing the engineering growth environment.

rules.explanation: Accepting initial offers without counter-proposing or negotiating respectfully leaves professional value and growth opportunities uncaptured.
rules.do: Conduct market research on standard entry-level compensation, articulate counter-proposals based on verified alternative offers or unique project skills, and maintain a collaborative tone.
rules.dont: Do not make aggressive ultimatums, issue demands without supporting market data, or burn professional bridges during negotiations.

rules.explanation: Signing employment or internship agreements without reviewing clauses regarding intellectual property, working hours, and non-compete terms can create unexpected legal risks.
rules.do: Review all clauses in the employment contract thoroughly, clarifying expectations around working hours, NDA terms, and intellectual property rights before signing.
rules.dont: Do not sign legal employment agreements hurriedly without reading and clarifying ambiguous contract clauses.

rules.rule_name: Graceful Offer Acceptance and Rejection Protocols
rules.explanation: Ghosting recruiters or abruptly declining offers after verbal commitments damages your professional reputation within the tight-knit tech community.
rules.do: Communicate decisions promptly and professionally to all interviewing companies, expressing gratitude for their time and keeping networks open.
rules.dont: Do not ghost hiring managers or renege on signed agreements without exceptional circumstances.
